paragraphs.text: We report a layered oxide cathode that retained 83.1% of its initial discharge capacity after 200 cycles, outperforming the undoped baseline of 71.4%.
Layered oxide cathodes were cycled at 1C in the voltage window of 2.8-4.3 V for 200 cycles at 25 C.
Table 1 | Sample | Capacity retention (%) | Rate | Doped 83.1 | Undoped 71.4 | Note that the doped electrode shows 83.1 percent retention after 200 cycles.
After 200 cycles the doped sample retained 83.1% of its discharge capacity, whereas the undoped baseline retained 71.4% under identical conditions.
Figure 2. Charge-discharge profiles of the doped cathode at 1C after 200 cycles; the discharge capacity retention reached 83.1%.
Supplementary Table S2. Coulombic efficiency of the doped electrode was 99.2% after 200 cycles at 1C and 25 C.
XPS results suggest that surface oxygen loss may contribute to the capacity fade, and the effect was more pronounced at 2C.
The specific discharge capacity of the doped cathode was 178 mAh/g at 0.1C, compared with 165 mAh/g for the undoped reference.
